title: This Vacuum Disappointed Me -- And Not Easy To Glide Over My Carpet As Advertised
text:
This Vacuum Disappointed Me -- And Not Easy To Glide Over My Carpet As Advertised. Considering its very high price and the positives touted by Oreck in the description, I am very disappointed with this vacuum.

They claim it glides easily over carpeting, as if we are using one of those self-propelled vacuums. While it feels this way while using it over bare floors, it in no way feels like this when pushing over carpeting. In fact, it's a definite slightly strained physical push over carpeting when the power is set to high (and I have low pile carpets). It is less of a hard push when the vacuum is set to low power, but it is in no way an easy glide as advertised.

The clip to hold the cord at the top rear of the vacuum and the light at the bottom of the vacuum is a joke. The cord easily pops out of the clip with very little effort while vacuuming. And the light has almost no illumination power.

Yes, the vacuum is very light weight, the swiveling works as advertised, and the suction is very good.

Bottom Line: It's very good for bare floors and zero-pile carpets (as it's a pleasure to glide along the floors and the suction is good). But for carpets, it's way too expensive to be as disappointing as I found it.

features: Slim swivel design: Enables you to turn on a dime and lies virtually flat so you can easily maneuver around and reach under furniture.

Auto shut off: The Belt protects the motor by preventing the brush roll from jamming if clothing or a rug is ever caught.Cord Length:30 ft

Multi-surface: Versatile and highly effective at cleaning virtually any floor surface in your home, from long pile carpet to hard floors. It will automatically adjust to the highest carpet pile with no manual adjustments needed.
description: Meet Magnesium RS, the newest addition to the Oreck Magnesium model line! Like the original Magnesium, it's got incredible suction power but more features. At 7. 7 pounds*, Magnesium RS is the lightest, full-powered, swivel-steering upright vacuum cleaner in America. With its new Slim Swivel Design and furniture-friendly, low-profile physique it's an effortless way to maneuver around any obstacle and clean every floor in your home—upstairs and downstairs. The wireless two-speed Quick Switch in the handle enables you to select the right power levels and move smoothly across all floor types. The large, high-performance wheels give Magnesium RS the agility it needs for every surface, from hardwood and tile to plush and frieze carpet without stopping for manual adjustments. It's so lightweight that carrying it upstairs is a cinch and so powerful it feels self-propelled.
